verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a payments platform with a merchant Customer Area, so the axis applies. The pack never documents an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The MCP server runs locally and is used from the user's own external LLM client. Uplift offers AI-driven optimization and recommendations, not task delegation. The agentic-commerce APIs serve third-party shopper agents. All of these are adjacent features rather than a built-in assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
